cohort: Pregnant individuals from whom placental bed biopsy tissues were obtained, divided into groups with preeclampsia (n=30) and normotensive controls (n=30).
finding: The expression of AnnexinA1 (AnxA1) and Galectin-3 (Gal-3) was significantly increased in the placental bed of pregnancies with preeclampsia compared to the normotensive control group (P < 0.001).
cross-section timing: At the time of placental bed biopsy, from pregnancies with and without preeclampsia.
